title: Structure ring and canonical comparison data for etale line modules
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Put $\mathcal O_{X_{\mathrm{et}}}(u:U\to X)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. For an ordinary invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], let $A_X(L)=L_{\mathrm{et}}$ be the associated sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], with its sectionwise $\mathcal O_{X_{\mathrm{et}}}$-module action; for a module morphism $h:L\to K$, let $A_X(h)_u=\Gamma(U,u^*h)$, where module pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback]. A line module on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ is a sheaf of $\mathcal O_{X_{\mathrm{et}}}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] which becomes isomorphic to $\mathcal O_{X_{\mathrm{et}}}$ on the localized sites of some jointly surjective etale family $U_a\to X$.  The identity, unit and composition comparisons are the unit-normalized tensor-pullback comparisons [def-pc-module-pullback].

source.place: Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), part (2); Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), finite local freeness, specialized to rank one; Tag 03LC (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent-functorial), part (1), for pullback compatibility. The equivalence is restricted to invertible modules.
